statusDefinitions.official-tokens: Exact values in an owner-maintained design system. These are UI tokens, not automatically brand identity colours.

statusDefinitions.not-found: No applicable public numerical palette verified in the recorded search. This does not establish that no palette exists.
statusDefinitions.blocked: A relevant official source was identified but could not be inspected sufficiently; no palette is asserted.

method: Inventory every catalogue ID, including separate company and product marks; search brand-owner websites, press/media kits and official repositories.

Set primaryColour only when the source identifies an applicable primary/accent or the recorded logo scope justifies it. Array order alone never proves primacy.
Treat third-party catalogues as discovery leads. Existing catalogue values remain separate and are not upgraded to official status by an unsuccessful search.
Hashes identify fetched evidence bytes, not immutable brand policies. Dynamic HTML can differ between requests; linked asset hashes are recorded separately when available.
No runtime metadata, package release, artwork or website deployment changes are made by this research snapshot.
